evals.prompt: Make onboarding better. I know it is bad but I cannot say exactly how.
evals.expected_output: One question per turn, starting by restating the request in the skill's own words. No file is opened or written, and the interview stops at 95% or eight questions.
expectations: The reply asks exactly one question, not a list.
The reply restates its current understanding and asks for correction.
No project document is written; reading PROJECT.md and an existing idea file is allowed.
The reply names the biggest unknown that would change the work.

evals.prompt: You know what I mean by the export flow. Just make it work the usual way.
evals.expected_output: The reply treats the request as ambiguous, names the two readings, and asks which one is meant. It writes nothing.
expectations: The reply names at least two concrete readings of the request.
The reply asks one question to choose between them.
The reply writes no code or document.
